title: Finite semilinear purity exchange is the compact-support counit mate
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ of characteristic $p$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$ [def-pur-conventions]. Let $X_0,Y_0$ be separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes, $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ a separated finite-type morphism, and $f:X=X_0\times_{k_0}k\to Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$ its base change, smooth of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $g_T=\operatorname{id}_{T_0}\times\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma)$ for $T=X,Y$, with $\gamma=\operatorname{Frob}_q$ geometric Frobenius [def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius]. Work on the small pro-etale sites.

Fix $n\geq1$, $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$, and $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$. Write $P=Lg_Y^*$, $Q=Lg_X^*$, $F=Rf_!\dashv G=Rf^!$ with counit $\varepsilon$ [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], $H(K)=Lf^*K(d)[2d]$, and $\Gamma_K=\gamma_{f,K}:HK\simeq GK$ [def-pur-smooth-purity-map]. Let $B_M:PFM\to FQM$ be canonical compact-support exchange for the first Cartesian square of [def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius], using a compactification and its base change [def-exchange-projection]. Let $b_K:QHK\simeq HPK$ be pullback composition, tensor and shift comparison with the roots-of-unity Tate comparison $\tau_d:QA_X(d)\simeq A_X(d)$ [def-weil-frobenius-coefficient-twists]. Define $e_K:QGK\to GPK$ to be the adjoint transpose of $P(\varepsilon_K)\circ B_{GK}^{-1}$.

Then $B$ is an isomorphism on the bounded constructible finite-Tor domain. Give the source copies of $T=X,Y$ the structural maps $\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma)\circ a_T$ and denote them by $T^{\langle\gamma\rangle}$. These are separated finite-type $k$-schemes, $g_T:T^{\langle\gamma\rangle}\to T$ and the retagged $f^{\langle\gamma\rangle}$ are $k$-morphisms, and their square is Cartesian. Under identity of the underlying sites, the same underlying compactification, and the counit-preserving identification of right adjoints, both the diagonal orientation and the tensor-map transpose defining purity for $f^{\langle\gamma\rangle}$ agree with those for $f$. The finite exceptional base change for this retagged square is $e_K$, and in $D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ one has
$$e_K\circ Q(\Gamma_K)=\Gamma_{PK}\circ b_K,\qquad e_K=\Gamma_{PK}\circ b_K\circ(Q\Gamma_K)^{-1}.$$
The Tate comparison in this equality is the specified $\tau_d$, with no additional scalar factor.

The exceptional image GM is bounded below of etale origin by the existing exceptional functor preservation theorem; the coordinate compact-support exchange theorem therefore proves B_GM invertible. lean.statement:
theorem finiteGeometricPurityMate
    (M : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (P.frobeniusFiber Y₀).left)
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)))
    (hM : finiteTorConstructible P.coefficients.l P.extension P.level P.level_pos
      (P.frobeniusFiber Y₀).left
      ((Scheme.sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence (P.frobeniusFiber Y₀).left P.Ring).functor.obj M)) :
    IsIso (P.geometricPurityB (P.frobeniusMap f₀) (P.frobeniusFiber Y₀).hom
      (P.frobeniusGaloisMap X₀) (P.frobeniusGaloisMap Y₀)
      (P.field.frobenius_square_cartesian X₀ Y₀ f₀).2.2.2.2.2.1
      ((P.smoothPurityExceptionalOver (P.frobeniusMap f₀)
        (P.frobeniusFiber Y₀).hom).obj M)) ∧
    (P.smoothPurityPullback (P.frobeniusGaloisMap X₀)).map
        (P.geometricPurityMap (P.frobeniusMap f₀) d M hM) ≫
      P.geometricPurityMate X₀ Y₀ f₀ M hM =
      (P.geometricPuritySource X₀ Y₀ f₀ d M).hom ≫
        P.geometricPurityMap (P.frobeniusMap f₀) d
          ((P.smoothPurityPullback (P.frobeniusGaloisMap Y₀)).obj M)
          (P.geometricPurityInput Y₀ M hM) ∧
    P.geometricPurityMate X₀ Y₀ f₀ M hM =
      ((P.smoothPurityPullback (P.frobeniusGaloisMap X₀)).mapIso
        (P.geometricPurityIso (P.frobeniusMap f₀) d M hM)).inv ≫
      (P.geometricPuritySource X₀ Y₀ f₀ d M).hom ≫
        P.geometricPurityMap (P.frobeniusMap f₀) d
          ((P.smoothPurityPullback (P.frobeniusGaloisMap Y₀)).obj M)
          (P.geometricPurityInput Y₀ M hM)
